rules: Every tropical storm of 1981 or later in IBTrACS whose track crosses the map, drawn year by year.

A track is coloured by the storm's sustained wind at each point (the US agency's 1-minute wind, else the wind of the WMO agency, a 10-minute wind): tropical depression below 34 knots, tropical storm 34-63 knots, typhoon 64 knots or more.
